applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusEn: Protonation controls net charge.

applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusEn: Balance all ionisable groups.

applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusDe: Projektionen erhalten Konfiguration; Anomerie betrifft C1.

goal.currentDescriptionEn: The learner can carry out and evaluate controlled Fehling assays, or Benedict assays required by the curriculum route, and explain positive and negative carbohydrate results through accessible carbonyl forms and anomeric-centre linkages.

applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: Execution evidence records volumes, time, conditions and controls. Expected glucose Cu2O precipitate, sucrose/water negative. Accessible carbonyl forms versus both bound anomeric centres; Fehling is not glucose specific.
applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandDe: Führe im betreuten Schulversuch einen kontrollierten Fehling-Nachweis aus: je2mL1%Glucose, Saccharose, Wasser; je2mL frisch1: 1gemischtes Fehling I/II; 5min80°C-Wasserbad. applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandEn: Carry out a supervised controlled Fehling assay: 2mL each1%glucose, sucrose, water; 2mL freshly1: 1mixed Fehling i/II; 5min80°C water bath. Label, use separate pipettes, record actual colour/precipitate, time/temperature and explain findings.
applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusEn: Execute, control and explain structurally.

applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandEn: A second supervised run replaces sucrose with maltose and fructose under identical conditions. Execute, compare controls and explain why ketose fructose can still test positive.

applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceDe: Drei Estergruppen verbinden Glycerin mit Resten. cis-Knick vermindertregelmäßige Packung, häufigniedrigerer Schmelzbereich; Gemisch/Kettenlänge beeinflussen. Fettistkein Polyester mitunbegrenzter Kettenlänge.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: Three esters link glycerol/residues. cis kinks reduce packing, often lower melting ranges; mixture/chain length matter. Fat is not an indefinite polyester.
applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandDe: Zeichne ein Triacylglycerid aus Glycerin unddrei Fettsäureresten, markiere Estergruppen. Vergleiche gesättigte undcis-ungesättigte Reste bei ähnlicher Kettenlänge und erkläre unterschiedliche Schmelzbereiche.
applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandEn: Draw triacylglycerol from glycerol and three fatty acid residues, mark esters. Compare saturated/cis unsaturated residues at similar length and explain melting ranges.
applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusEn: Explain properties from specific structure.

applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceDe: Reagenzverbrauch wirdbei gleicher Probe/Tropfengröße/Schüttelzeit verglichen; mehrreduzierbare C=C kanngrößeren Verbrauch erklären. Braunstein/Entfärbung erwartet. Andereoxidierbare Stoffe/Emulsion stören; keinexakter Fettsäureanteil ohnespezifische Kalibrierung.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: Compare consumption with same amount, drop size, mixing time. More oxidisable C=C may consume more; decolourisation/MnO2 expected. Other oxidisable substances/emulsions interfere; no precise composition without calibration.
applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandDe: Führe betreut den halbquantitativen Baeyer-Vergleich aus: je1mLModellöl in5mLHeptan, parallel Heptanleerprobe; frischdefiniertes Baeyer-Reagenz tropfenweisezugeben, jeweils10s schütteln und Zeit/Temperatur/Tropfenzahl biszur30s beständigen Violettfärbung protokollieren. Vergleiche zwei Öle unddeutealsbegrenzten Ungesättigtheitstest.
applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandEn: Execute supervised semiquantitative Baeyer comparison: 1ml each model oil in5mL heptane with heptane blank; add fresh defined Baeyer reagent dropwise, shake10s and log time, temperature/drop count until purple persists30s. Compare oils as bounded unsaturation test.
applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusEn: Experiment with bounded structural inference.

applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceDe: Violett bei geeigneter Peptidprobe; Glycin/Wasser keine Biuret-Positivkontrolle. CuII koordiniert in alkalischer Lösung geeignete Peptid-Stickstoffdonoren; blauer Cu(OH)2-Niederschlag bei Reagenzüberschuss ist keinvioletter Proteinbefund.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: Suitable peptide sample violet; glycine/water are not positive biuret controls. Cu(II) coordinates suitable peptide N donors in alkali; blue Cu(OH)2 precipitate from excess reagent is not a violet protein result.

Proben beschriften, getrennte Pipetten verwenden, tatsächliche Farben/Niederschläge aufzeichnen. Deute mit Peptidgruppen.
applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandEn: Execute a supervised biuret series: 2mL each diluted eggwhite, 1%glycine, water; add1mL1mol/L NaOH and10drops0.1mol/L CuSO4, mix gently, label, use separate pipettes and record actual colours/precipitates. Explain using peptide groups.
applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusDe: Durchführung und Koordination am kontrollierten Test verbinden.
applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusEn: Link controlled execution to coordination.

applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: Protein control checks reagent function; dilution can fall below detection limit. Negative means not detected under conditions, not absence of all peptide bonds; no unique amino acid identification.

applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandEn: Execute another series using gelatin and a strongly diluted gelatin sample. Explain weak/absent colour and detection limits; record controls and actual execution.
